_doc: Official pages to watch for a published 2027 programme (watch_programmes.py). `seen` = where the address was found and when; party pages are marked attribution 'parti'. Candidates without an entry have no official site found: François Hollande (not a declared candidate; no personal site; Parti socialiste pages are attached to Olivier Faure), Bruno Retailleau (only the LR party page; no personal campaign site found), Jordan Bardella (RN site only). marinelepen.fr is a parked domain (SCORE online marketing) and is deliberately not listed.
